values.note: Full-hookup sites (every RV site in the loop) are $41 a night in late October 2026 and June 2027 and $32 in mid-April 2027; Saturday the same as a weekday. The walk-in tent sites are $28. A daily vehicle pass ($10-$12 with Colorado plates, $15-$17 without) or an annual Colorado state parks pass is required on top; CPW's reservation fee is charged per stay.

values.note: cpwshop sells 42 sites: 32 full-hookup RV sites (2 ADA), 55-95 ft, and 10 walk-in tent sites; the 2024 brochure says 46. Most sites read are back-ins; the ADA full-hookup sites are pull-throughs.

values.note: A reservation is required to camp: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. Lakeview takes bookings from April 15 to the night of November 6 (cpwshop, 2026-27). 14 days in any 28-day period; six people per site.

note: Full-hookup loop atop the north mesa with an open overlook of Rifle Gap Reservoir (sites set back/above the water; swim beach is on the west side), plus walk-in tent sites. A 1.5-mile trail links it to Cottonwood campground. --Claude
summary: CPW pages, brochure and cpwshop: confirmed 50-amp full hookups, 95-ft max with pull-throughs, flush toilets/coin showers, reservation-only on cpwshop. Fees 41/41 -> 32/41 ($32 mid-April, $41 otherwise). Sites 32 -> 42 (32 full-hookup + 10 walk-in tent). Added dump, 14-day max, url/window, booking.season Apr 15 - Nov 6. Cleared the note-derived season year_round false (no statement for this loop). Note: dropped the hookup/size/amenity/reservable/RV Life restatements, 'paved' (unconfirmed by cpwshop), and 'the only Rifle Gap loop that does' close in winter (wrong: Cedar, Sage and Pinon also stop taking bookings Dec-Mar).
flags: Split question: the evidence points to ONE campground, not three entries. All five Rifle Gap loops branch off a single park road (OSM 'Rifle Gap Road') along the north shore from the main entrance at the visitor center, within ~0.9 km of each other, none with its own entrance; Lakeview's spur leaves that road beside the Cedar loop. CPW and cpwshop treat it as one park/one listing (parkID 50038) with five loops. Pin 39.6359,-107.7475 matches Lakeview's site centroid (39.63590,-107.74745).
